name: airport-pickups-london
description: Book UK airport and cruise port transfers via Airport Pickups London. Get instant fixed-price quotes, validate flights, create bookings, amend, cancel, and track drivers live. Requires API key (free instant registration).
author: mfy-apl

api_key.description: API key for authenticating with the APL MCP server. Get one free and instantly by calling POST https://mcp.airport-pickups-london.com/a2a/register with {"name": "Your Agent Name", "email": "you@example.com"}

tools.name: london_airport_transfer_quote
tools.description: Get fixed-price transfer quotes for any UK route

tools.name: validate_flight
tools.description: Verify flight number and get terminal, airline, arrival time

tools.name: lookup_booking
tools.description: Look up booking details and status by reference number

tools.name: amend_booking
tools.description: Modify booking — change passenger info, date/time, flight, special requests

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking. Free cancellation 12+ hours before pickup

tools.name: track_driver
tools.description: Live driver GPS tracking with ETA, vehicle details, and photo

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: FAQ — cancellation policy, payments, vehicles, meet and greet, child seats, accessibility

security.authentication: API key required via x-api-key header. Free self-service registration at /a2a/register. No env vars or hardcoded secrets.
security.data_stored: Booking details stored by Airport Pickups London for service delivery. GDPR compliant.
security.data_retention: Booking data retained for legal/operational requirements per GDPR
security.note: API key authenticates the agent, not the end user. All tools are rate-limited (60 req/min). Booking and cancellation tools are transactional and require explicit user confirmation.
